reviews.text: I've never felt so safe leaving my dog ​​in a shelter. They were absolutely perfect, well-prepared, and super kind. The areas were spacious, and the indoor area was super comfortable. Thank you for everything.

We left our English bulldog at this kennel for 20 days. I was apprehensive because it's a special breed, requiring attention and care, but we had a great time here. The staff are attentive, professional, and kind. Our dog had a wonderful time, as demonstrated by the fact that he came home without dermatitis, which had happened at another kennel. It means he felt comfortable and was treated excellently. We would definitely bring him back
if we couldn't take him on vacation with us. Highly recommended!

We left our Lara there for a few days and were truly delighted. From the very first moment, we found attentive, competent, and empathetic staff, capable of caring for the animals with great professionalism and affection. It was reassuring to know that Lara was in good hands, and upon our return, we found her calm and happy. We recommend this boarding house to anyone looking for a reliable place to leave their four-legged friend. Thank you so much!

I left my dog ​​at this boarding house for a few days and was truly satisfied. The staff is competent, helpful, and genuinely loves animals. My dog ​​was looked after with care, had plenty of space to play, and when I returned, I found him happy and in great shape (he actually didn't want to go home). The facility is clean, well-organized, and inspires trust from the moment I arrived. I recommend this boarding house to anyone looking for a safe and welcoming place to leave their four-legged friend. We will definitely be back; it will be our trusted boarding house.

We love Vacanza da Leo ! Our dog Kimba absolutely adores coming here — you can tell she’s genuinely happy and comfortable. The staff are so attentive and kind, and it’s clear they really care about the dogs, not just look after them. I’d highly recommend them to anyone looking for a boarding school for their babies. Grazie tante Simone & Claudio.

Before leaving Mia at this kennel, we had a thousand anxieties and fears, as in seven years she had never been in a kennel and had never been in contact with so many dogs. From day one, however, we felt at ease thanks to the professionalism and passion of the entire staff.
Every day they sent us videos, allowing us to see Mia at peace, playing and having fun. This really made a difference for us. When she returned, we found her calm, relaxed, and happy, a sign that she had been cared for with so much love and attention. For us, it was an experience that exceeded all expectations. Knowing that we could leave with a light heart, confident that Mia was loved and cared for just like at home, is priceless. We will definitely return to you and entrust Mia to you again with the same trust, because we know she will always be in wonderful hands. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for everything you do!
Nina had a great time and had a lot of fun, I recommend Leo's Holiday to everyone

After several negative experiences (including, sadly, the tragic loss of one of my beloved dogs during a stay at a "very well-known" facility), I reluctantly had to look for a place to care for my bulldog again, after years.

Encouraged by the reviews, although they hadn't proven to be a true guarantee of quality in the past, I chose the folks at "In Vacanza da Leo."

From the moment Claudio answered the phone to provide me with information, I sensed the professionalism and attention with which they truly care for the animals entrusted to their facility. There, I also met Simone, who, along with Claudio, cared for my grumpy old man, Odino, over 11 years old.

Beyond constant reassurance, and understanding my inevitable apprehension stemming from the traumatic memory of what happened in the past, they demonstrated a sensitivity that goes far beyond simple boarding. They are kind, friendly, caring, and simply delightful. They even took care of the grooming before bringing him back to my house at the end of the stay (two extra services that are absolutely useful, and not to be taken for granted!)

My review can be summed up like this: I felt like a terrified parent who finds peace of mind because they've finally found the perfect babysitter to whom they can blindly entrust their child, knowing they'll take loving care of him.

I can't find a more fitting metaphor to express my gratitude and newfound peace of mind, because today I know I can count on them in the future too. And in fact, I've already done so, booking two more mini-stays.

Entrust yourself to them blindly.

We left our Cane Corso puppy, Iron, at the Da Leo dog kennel for a weekend and then dropped him off when we leave in August, and we couldn't be happier with the experience.

From the very first moment, we found a welcoming, professional environment, run by truly attentive and passionate people. During his stay, Iron was looked after with care; they sent us videos, and he was able to socialize with other dogs and have fun in the company of others. We were particularly pleased to learn that he also played happily with another dog, enjoying moments of fun and socialization in complete tranquility.

When we returned, we found a calm, happy, and healthy dog, a clear sign of the care he received. For us owners, there is no greater satisfaction than leaving with the knowledge of leaving our four-legged friend in safe hands.

We sincerely thank the entire Da Leo dog kennel staff for their helpfulness, kindness, and love for the animals they show every day. We recommend this kennel to anyone looking for a reliable place to leave their dog with complete peace of mind.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommended! 🐶❤️
Very kind, knowledgeable, and attentive to the dogs' well-being. Beautiful, well-maintained place!

I'd never left Bart alone, he'd never been away from home before. That said, I can happily say we're very satisfied and happy! The dog is doing great, he came back happy, he definitely had some experience, and he was able to run outside. The guys are great and do everything they can to accommodate the requests of worried owners!
Thank you!
Serious and passionate people who do their work with great care and love!!!

Great experience with them taking great care of our two dogs for 2.5 weeks! Sent daily videos showing them playing with other dogs and just being happy. They offer to bathe your dog before you return so they come back clean. Will definitely use again.

I left my little dog Chicco, a little pincherino, for the first time in 7 years, for 5 days and I was super anxious and worried, but I found Simone and his staff to be perfect and took care of my little dog as if I were myself, attentive to his every need and above all, they reassured me with videos and messages. Thank you so much for everything.
It's clear that in addition to your expertise, you put your heart into it. They also have a school bus service and came to pick up and take my puppy home.
See you soon, guys.

It's not easy to find someone to whom you can entrust your puppy with complete peace of mind, but with Iris we hit the nail on the head. This daycare is a paradise for dogs: spacious spaces, stimulating activities, and, above all, a staff who truly love animals. Iris goes home tired but very happy, and I feel at ease knowing she's in expert and loving hands. Thank you for your passion!
Highly recommended.

I had to go away for two weeks on vacation and didn't know who to leave my dog ​​with. Luckily, I heard about this dog boarding facility from a friend who had a great experience, and my experience was no different. I called and the staff were immediately very helpful. Simone took such good care of Zeus that I had a hard time taking him away when I returned.
Excellent service, highly recommended!

A clean,
organized, and reliable dog boarding facility! Thanks to the team for keeping my dog ​​in perfect company! I'll definitely be back.

The place is amazing, and the staff even more so!
I recommend it to everyone.

A welcoming and family-friendly place, my puppy Giada had a wonderful time. The staff who run it are always helpful and kind.
My puppy went home feeling calm and happy, and this is thanks to the great love she received from the owners of this wonderful dog boarding facility.
Thank you again, Massimiliano Pellegrino.
The staff is attentive and knowledgeable. Open spaces and freedom. Excellent! We'll be back.

I give this property 5 stars because I find it perfect!! The staff is polite and knowledgeable, they welcomed my Rudy with love! My big puppy had a wonderful time...you can tell by the videos they sent me every day during my vacation. Highly recommended.

*5 out of 5 stars* ⭐️
I'm truly satisfied with the welcome and care Maty received at this dog boarding facility! From day one, it was clear that they were kind and loving. Maty is a family dog, used to being alone with his family, and is usually very wary of strangers. However, he immediately felt at ease with them.
The staff was incredible: they immediately made him feel at ease, petting him and playing with him. It was amazing to see how they treated him with love and care, just like a member of the family.
The facility is clean and welcoming, and the fact that they dedicated time and attention to Maty made all the difference. They were always available for updates and photos, and they made me and my family feel at ease knowing Maty was in good hands.
If you have a dog like Maty, don't hesitate to choose this boarding facility—it's truly a special place. Thank you so much for making Maty feel at home!

For a few days, we entrusted our puppy to Fabiana, Simone, and Claudio. They were truly exceptional, constantly reassuring us, and above all, you could see that our Mia was doing great... Talk about work done with love and professionalism! Thanks guys!
Fantastic experience. The guys were super helpful and attentive. I was always kept updated on how my kimbo was doing. Thanks for everything, I'll definitely be back.
Eight days of pure fun in the greenery and fresh air! Speck and Braciola thank the team's friends!

A very positive experience. On the staff's advice, we did an initial one-day trial to see how the dog (a 6-year-old German Shepherd who never left our side) would react to separation, in preparation for the subsequent four-day "stay"... and it went very well. The staff are very welcoming, professional, attentive, and empathetic. They sent us updates
(supported by videos) every day, sometimes even before we asked for information about the dog. This gave us greater peace of mind. I absolutely recommend it.

Claudio, Simone, and Fabiana inspired trust from the very first moment: it's clear how much they care about the animals' well-being. My Zack was welcomed with care and affection, he's attending daycare, and he's receiving impeccable care. I also take advantage of the boarding service when needed. Another very convenient service is the taxi: they're punctual, organized, and super helpful, a great added value, especially for those who are short on time or have trouble getting around.

I highly recommend this company. The guys are exceptional, and I had a great experience, so much so that my Golden Retriever will be returning to them for a few days soon. Highly recommended!!!! You couldn't have made a better choice.
My Kylie feels right at home with Claudio, Simone, and Fabiana. Fun, attention, and care are the watchwords! We couldn't have made a better choice!

We did a test and realized that Flash, our puppy, would settle in right away. So for our 15-day vacation, we used the "In Vacanza con Leo" boarding facility, and thanks to the helpfulness and professionalism of Simone and Claudio, and the sweetness of Fabiana, we saw how happy our puppy was when he returned from vacation. Flash will definitely be your guest again! Silvana

Recommended!
The staff are helpful, kind, polite, and well-trained, with a great love for animals.
I chose the monthly daycare option.
They update the outdoor area with daily photos and videos.
They are very attentive to the behavior and compatibility of all the dogs.
Positive experience.

I brought my dachshund and had a really great time. The place is welcoming and well-kept, and I felt at ease leaving him. When I came back to pick him up, he was happy and calm, a sign that he was treated with care and affection. I definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable place to leave their dog in peace!
Truly a happy place! Space to run and play and plenty of cuddles! Well done 💘 …
Super positive experience! Very kind and helpful staff.
I had a great time! And apparently my dog, too, came home tired and happy ☺️

We left our dog at this

kennel for a few days and had a really good time. It was our first time entrusting him to someone, and we were a little nervous, but from the first meeting, they instilled a lot of trust in us (along with the very friendly Simone).

The facility is well-kept and clean, and you can tell the dogs aren't just "kenneled," but are cared for and let out regularly. The staff is kind and helpful, always ready to provide information and updates.

When we returned to pick him up, we found him calm and serene, a sign that he was well-treated and felt at ease.

If we ever need help again, we would definitely come back here. Recommended
I had a great experience. Simone is very passionate about his work.

Excellent facility, super attentive staff.

I absolutely recommend it to everyone for peace of mind when you need to leave your pets.

A fantastic place to leave your four-legged friend. Capable, helpful, and responsible staff.
I'd leave my dog ​​at three a thousand times over.

I can only give In vacanza da Leo 5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I want to thank them for the incredible patience, professionalism, and expertise they showed with my Yoshi, an American Akita with a strong personality. It's not always easy to care for such a breed, but they were simply impeccable.

Very polite, helpful, always kind, and above all, knowledgeable. You can tell they do this job with true passion and a great love for animals. They always kept me updated and made me feel at ease knowing Yoshi was in good hands.

It's rare to find such dedicated, competent, and detail-oriented people. I would definitely recommend this daycare to anyone looking for a safe and reliable place for their dog.

Thank you again from the bottom of my heart from Yoshi and me! 🐾
I took my pitbull to Simone and Fabiana. They were super caring and helpful. I made a fantastic choice with them. Thank you for everything. I would choose you 1,000 times over. See you soon.

Fabiana and Simone are truly special, sweet, and trustworthy people!
I highly recommend them.

Smart and well-mannered people; you can immediately tell they're passionate about their work. The open-ended daycare option is very versatile. They pay close attention to the behavior of the various guests and to their compatibility.
Try it, you won't be disappointed.
I left my poodle at their facility for a weekend. The staff is reliable, kind, and competent; the facility is very nice.

I left my dog ​​at this kennel for a few days, and since I'm not a local, it was a lifesaver. The facility is well-maintained, welcoming, and peaceful. Simone, who manages the facility, was kind, attentive, and knowledgeable, keeping me updated with photos and messages. My dog ​​returned calm and happy. Highly recommended!

I left my Spitz, Vicky, for the first time, and I have to say it was a super positive experience. I was worried because she's a house dog, but this boarding kennel is perfect for house dogs because it's safe and well-organized. I get daily videos and updates, which gave me peace of mind. Vicky went home happy and in great health. I'm super happy. I highly recommend it.

Fantastic staff and a fantastic atmosphere!
I brought my dog ​​Clint and we had a great time. He had a great time and enjoyed being with other dogs (he's a German Shepherd, even a large one).
We'll definitely be back!
Thanks for your feed

I had to leave for a trip abroad and didn't know where to leave Luna for a few days.
It was the first time I couldn't leave her with loved ones, and I was terrified. Until, after a couple of less-than-reassuring attempts, I met Simone, who immediately put me at ease and welcomed me into his beautiful kennel after just a few hours. I was amazed by the naturalness and love with which he immediately connected with Luna.
Additionally, due to an accident during the trip, the stay lasted longer than expected... but the staff provided constant updates on Luna's condition, and seeing her so happy and serene filled my heart with joy.
Which is why, as soon as I need her, I no longer have any doubts about where to leave her.
Thanks again, guys!!
The guys are awesome! Thanks for everything :)
The best I've ever found!
Grace had a really great time. Having both an indoor and outdoor space was perfect. The guys are fantastic!
Very nice staff, a real passion for animals

Excellent place to let our furry friends run around. The staff is kind and always available. My dog ​​still goes through this experience because she burns off a lot of energy both from the space reserved for them and from the contact with other dogs. I thank all the staff for what they do for my "little" MIA
❤️

I left my dog ​​at this boarding house and couldn't be happier! The facility is clean, spacious, and very well organized, with areas for play and rest. The staff is extremely kind, professional, and truly loves animals: my dog ​​came back happy, calm, and pampered. Rating: 10
Charlie didn't want to go home because he had fun on vacation with Leo and breathed the healthy air of nature. Claudio and Simone became his uncles.

A truly positive experience! I dropped off my dog ​​Willy and was absolutely thrilled. You can tell the animals are cared for with love and attention. Willy came back feeling calm and happy, a sign he'd had a wonderful time. The staff were kind and helpful, and the environment was clean and well-kept. I highly recommend it!
Ideal place for a dog daycare, kind and very well trained staff, dogs are treated with love

I dropped my dog ​​off at this boarding facility and had a truly wonderful experience. Impeccable service, fair prices, and extremely professional and caring staff. It's clear they love animals and take care of them with care and passion. I left my dog ​​with complete peace of mind and found him happy and calm. Highly recommended to anyone looking for a reliable, quality place.

Congratulations and thank you again for the way you welcomed and treated my dog ​​Doroty.
I fully recommend this facility to everyone. The staff is professional, courteous, and always attentive and caring for our furry friends.
Thanks again, we'll definitely be back. 😘❣️

I brought my two dogs to this boarding facility in the days following an operation because I couldn't care for them as I would have liked. I immediately felt at ease: the staff were kind, helpful, and truly attentive to the animals' well-being.
Every time I asked for information, they were quick to respond, and they sent me videos of the dogs, which reassured me greatly during their recovery. The facility has both an indoor space where the dogs can stay away from the elements and an outdoor space for running, playing, etc. My dogs were cared for and pampered like they were at home.
It was a super positive experience; I absolutely recommend it to anyone looking for a serious and reliable boarding facility 🐶❤️🐶

I left my little Roy for the first time for three days, and I couldn't have made a better choice. The three people who run the kennel were incredibly kind, reliable, and attentive to my dog's needs, making me feel at ease from the very first moment by sending me photos and videos.
You can tell they do this job with passion and love for animals. When I returned, I found a calm and happy dog, a sign that he was treated very well. I highly recommend this kennel to anyone looking for care, professionalism, and lots of affection for their four-legged friend!

My little Leo's first experience... I had a lot of concerns because he's a dog used to the couch and fireplace, very homely... but he had a great time!!! The guys are ALL GREAT!!!! Very helpful, attentive to the needs of each individual dog, they sent me videos of my dog ​​playing happily with other dogs. They worried about whether he was eating or not and
they tried to gently help him settle in. They do it with love and it shows, especially the dogs, Leo went home happy... thank you for everything, until next time... I finally know who to entrust my little one to if I need him.

My Angie has been to daycare several times, from morning to night, having endless fun, and also for a short period with an overnight stay. He's still a puppy and full of energy, a half-Labrador, so running and socializing are very important to him. During the week, with work, I can only take him for short walks to do his business. Instead, I see that he really needs it to let off steam. I couldn't have found more reliable, affectionate, kind people, and a better facility, with a large outdoor space and a colorful and spacious indoor area for playing even when it rains. I recommend it to everyone, because when dogs go there, they are reborn!

I left my dog ​​at this boarding facility for a few days and couldn't have made a better choice. The facility is clean, well-organized, and in a peaceful environment. Fabiana and Simone are extremely kind, knowledgeable, and attentive to each animal's needs. They updated me regularly with photos and messages, giving me peace of mind during my absence. My dog ​​came home happy, calm, and in excellent health. You can truly see the love and passion they put into their work. I highly recommend In Vacanza da Leo to anyone looking for a safe and reliable place for their four-legged friend!

I left my little dog, who I'm always reluctant to part with, but today I can say I made an excellent choice! I found a well-kept environment, cared for by highly professional people! It's hard to find places like this, where the passion for the work is evident!
I highly recommend "In Vacanza da Leo"!

Fabulous structure, wonderful people with a great love for their work, very professional, they updated me every day with photos and even videos of my little Raffy, this morning after 6 days I went to pick up my little dog, I found a calm and serene furry baby, I am truly very happy, we will see each other again soon for sure ❤️ greetings from Pavia

I entrusted my dog ​​to Simone and Fabiana, they were incredible, very good, affectionate with him and sent me videos every day to make me feel more at ease, but I had no doubts about them!! Thank you so much again and I will definitely come back to them.

Friendly, helpful, and kind. My dog ​​has a lot of fun. Every time I've brought him, I've felt reassured leaving him with them because they're attentive and often send me videos, so I can be a part of my dog's day.
Leaving our four-legged friend behind for a few days is never easy, but here we immediately felt at ease. You can tell they truly love animals. We'll definitely be back!
Excellent service: friendly and knowledgeable staff, updates throughout our stay, and attentive to our dog's needs. A reliable kennel where you can leave your dogs in peace!
Fantastic experience! Our dog was welcomed with so much care and affection. The facility was clean, spacious, and safe. We found him calm and happy. Highly recommended! ♥️

A special thank you goes to Claudio and Simone for their endless patience with me: I contact them at any time of day, and they always find a way to respond with kindness, helpfulness, and attention. This kindness truly makes the difference.

Knowing that Sofia is with them gives me peace of mind, because I know she is loved, respected, and cared for with care. I couldn't have made a better choice.

Highly recommended to anyone looking not only for impeccable service, but also for heart, reliability, and true love.

I left my dog ​​alone for the first time in nine years, and I couldn't have chosen a better place. The guys were super helpful, friendly, and above all, reliable. My dog ​​came back happy and carefree, and we're incredibly satisfied. We'll choose you 100 times over!
They took care of my dog ​​Rhum. It's hard to find words to describe the affection, attention, care, and professionalism of the operators. Absolutely recommended!

I discovered them by chance online and was initially wary, having never left my puppy with anyone, but we decided to trust them and left him for the Immaculate Conception long weekend, and we were very happy with it.
The staff were kind and courteous, but above all, animal lovers. Our ATLAS had a great time and went home super happy and very tired from playing so much.
Recommended

I just returned from a week's vacation and entrusted my dog ​​to two truly fantastic people. From the very first moment, they instilled trust and professionalism, and throughout my absence, they kept me updated with messages and photos, making me feel at ease.
My dog ​​was treated like family, with walks, games, attention, and lots of cuddles. When I returned, I found him calm, relaxed, and perfectly at ease, a sign that he's truly enjoyed himself.
I recommend this facility to anyone looking for reliable and loving people to leave their four-legged friend with. Thank you so much for your care and availability; we will definitely trust you again! Thank you so much again.

Very positive experience: professionalism and comfort... Simone, Fabiana, and Claudio are very empathetic, and we immediately formed a special connection with my five dogs. Plus, our furry friends sleep warm!
Thanks guys 🐶🐶🐶🐶🐶 …

Fabiana and Simone, two young people who do their job with passion and dedication. Charlie had a wonderful time, and we, the owners, are happy and at peace to have left him in such good hands. We'll definitely see you again, thank you ♥️

I was looking for a safe place for my puppy to spend time outdoors with other puppies, and above all, a place cared for with love and attention by qualified people.
We found everything we needed, so much so that my puppy 🐶 never wants to stop playing and go home
🏠.
Thank you for existing!!!

Kind and super reliable guys.
I have an Amstaff and I didn't expect him to be so happy. Very satisfied.

I've been bringing my dog ​​here for a while now, and I have to say I've found the staff incredibly helpful and loving! Thanks to them, I've found a space where my dog ​​can run and play with other dogs in complete safety and fun! Highly recommended.

"On Vacation with Leo" is a place where you can leave your pet safe in the knowledge that they'll be treated with love and kindness! The staff at the boarding kennel are professional, kind, and incredibly helpful. Both the indoor and outdoor spaces are well-maintained, clean, and colorful!
Well-organized, welcoming, and clean dog boarding. The staff demonstrate a deep love for animals. I feel at peace when my big dog is there with them. Excellent prices. I am completely satisfied.
It was a wonderful experience for our Maltese. We found an excellent facility, with dedicated, knowledgeable, and professional staff who cared for and entertained our dog. We'll definitely be back.

What can I say? It's the only place where I can leave Raul and SN in peace, both in terms of boarding and daycare. And seeing Raul jump in the car when they come to pick him up is the guarantee of everything.

I left my Jordy with Claudio and Fabiana for a week in August. They were fabulous; my West Highland had a wonderful time and made lots of friends. They kept me updated with videos of my furry friend, allowing me to enjoy my trip abroad with peace of mind. I recommend this 5-star boarding house to everyone!

I'm absolutely satisfied with this dog boarding facility where I left my dog ​​Diego during my absence! The staff was welcoming and professional, and my dog ​​was treated with love and care. The facility is clean and comfortable, and Diego had the opportunity to play and socialize with the other dogs. I was constantly updated on my dog's health and well-being, and I was able to view the photos and videos sent to me. Thank you so much for the excellent service!
Fantastic guys.... The only thing I can say is that they truly love their job and do it with passion and dedication...

I have two very different dachshunds: one loves being held, the couch, and cuddles, while the other loves chasing a ball and rolling in the grass. I've found the perfect place for both of them; they get cuddled and can run free. Thanks to Simone and the daycare staff, my dogs are happier and more relaxed at the end of the day, and I feel at ease knowing they're in good hands, whether I leave them for a day or just for a few days. I also took advantage of the taxi service, which is very convenient and always on time! See you in September :) :)
We were looking for accommodation for our big boxer puppy. Fantastic welcome, top staff, and a spacious dog park. Highly recommended.

An absolutely positive experience. My dog, Leo, an extremely lively puppy, found the perfect environment. The staff were helpful, smiling, and empathetic. It took Leo very little time to settle in, he played a lot, and had a great time. The proof is that this morning, when I went to pick him up, I had to insist quite a bit to get him into the car. I was kept fully informed, including photos and videos, and I even took the opportunity to have him groomed. The prices are reasonable. I recommend it to everyone.

I left my dog ​​here for 5 days and I have to say I was very satisfied, from the videos they sent me I could see the dog relaxed and happy to play with other dogs in the open air and when I brought him home I found him very calm, when I can I will definitely bring him back even if it's just for a day!

I was looking for a boarding facility for my puppy, who was only 4 months old at the time. I found them somewhat by chance... and with a hint of skepticism, considering my expectations, I went to meet them one Saturday morning with my whole family... including my dog.
We were welcomed with such simplicity and kindness, and my Gioia immediately ended up in their arms.
I trust them.
First trial... 4 days
My little girl is immersed in nature, in contact with other four-legged friends, even those much older than her, and with her beloved Chico (a 6-month-old Pit Bull puppy). She runs, has fun, and is free to roll in the grass.
More trials will follow (I travel often in the summer), and each time I feel like I'm leaving her in safe and loving hands.
I couldn't have asked for better.
See you soon, guys.

I'm absolutely satisfied with the dog boarding facility that took in my puppy. With love, empathy, and time, they gave my dog ​​the space to open up and feel comfortable. The result was incredible: after just two days, my dog ​​Leo, who is difficult, phobic, and anxious, let me pet him and was calm and happy. I'm truly grateful for the care and attention he received. When he returned, he was better than ever! The energy release, the daily runs in the fields with his peers were just what he needed!
From the daily videos I received, I could tell by my dog's attitude and tail wagging that he was incredibly happy.
I highly recommend this boarding facility to all owners of anxious or shy dogs! 5 stars!!

My dog ​​is extremely wary, he won't let anyone approach him. He's 9 years old and had never been to a kennel before.
At "in vacanza da Leo," I found everything I needed: people who love animals in every way. They succeeded in getting my Leo close and loyal, and at the end of the "vacation," he even let me pet him like I'd never seen before. During the vacation, I consistently received videos that reassured me. I recommend this kennel; I'll definitely be back.
A spectacular place, huge and cool garages. The guys are always available with lots of daily photos.
